This shoulder-season window is ideal for a relaxed boat charter without the July–August rush. Whether you're eyeing the Astondoa 40 from €749/2h or the Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski, October delivers excellent value and near-perfect conditions.

Read on for weather data, pricing, boat recommendations, and practical tips to make the most of your Marbella boat rental this October.

Why October Shoulder Season Works

Summer in Marbella runs June through August – peak heat, peak prices, peak crowds. September holds the warmth but still busy. October flips the script: daytime temperatures hover 24–26°C, the sea sits at 22°C, and the marina at Puerto Banús is noticeably quieter. You'll find better availability on boats and often more flexible scheduling. For a Marbella boat rental October 2037 shoulder season experience, this is the sweet spot.

October Weather & Sea Conditions

Expect an average of 9 hours of sunshine per day. Rain is minimal – typically 3–4 days for the whole month. Winds are light, usually 5–10 knots, making for calm cruising along the Costa del Sol. Water temperature of 22°C means swimming is comfortable without a wetsuit. Evening temperatures drop to around 18°C, so bring a light jacket for the return trip.

Best Boats for October Charters

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús. For small groups (up to 9), the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a strong choice at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) follows the same Tier A pricing. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats like the Fairline Targa 12m or Pershing 46 are available – pricing on request via WhatsApp.

Where to Anchor & Swim in October

Popular anchorages include Cala del Faro (sheltered cove near Marbella), Cala Cortés (quiet beach with clear water), and the waters off Cabopino. Your skipper will choose the best spot based on wind direction. The sea is warm enough for swimming until late October. For lunch, you can stop at a chiringuito on the beach or eat aboard – your choice.
